transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because things just got a bit out of hand recently. 

I went from barely being settled into my new apartment to... I don't know, suddenly doing way too much. I started saying yes to all these mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototypes for work... I even started redesigning my entire portfolio. It was just... like I had to fix my whole life in one sprint. 

So... yeah. That's why I made the appointment.
Did you feel unusually happy or excited during this period of taking on a lot of activities?

I mean... I guess you could say I felt pretty upbeat for a bit. Earlier this month, it was almost like I was... electric, I suppose. Just really going. 

But then... I don't know, it wasn't all just feeling good. I'd feel fine one minute, and then... I'd just snap. Like, I yelled at this contractor at work, and I went off on my sister over practically nothing. Just tiny delays, but it felt like they were... I don't know, doing it on purpose to get in my way. So... yeah. It wasn't just being happy.
Have you experienced any periods of feeling sad, empty, or depressed in the past few months?

Yeah... I suppose. 

Um... lately, I just... I wake up with this heavy, kind of gray feeling in my chest. It's... I don't know. Even when the apartment is quiet and nothing bad is actually happening, I just... I feel like I could cry over a coffee mug in the sink. 

So... yeah. I guess I have.
How long have you been waking up with that heavy, gray feeling in your chest?

Um... I guess it's been a while. 

The heavier stretches... they kind of started showing up about 11 months ago. Around the time of... well, my separation. It was there even before this recent move made everything feel a bit sharper. 

So... yeah. About that long.
Did you experience any periods where you didn't need much sleep, yet still felt rested and had a lot of energy?

I guess... yeah. During that time I was feeling so upbeat... I wasn't really sleeping much. 

Maybe... I don't know, three or four hours a night for a few days. But I didn't feel tired. I just... I woke up feeling fine, like I didn't need any more sleep. I figured I should just get up and use the time to get ahead on things. So... yeah, I guess I did.
Did you feel like you were unusually talkative or had racing thoughts during that upbeat period?

Um... no. I don't think so. 

I was mostly just working by myself, so... I wasn't really talking to anyone anyway. And my mind just felt... focused, I guess. Not racing. So... no.
Have you noticed any decrease in interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?

Yeah... I suppose. 

Um... I used to like hiking up at Crowders, or... cooking something nice. Sometimes I'd sketch out interface ideas just for fun. But... I don't know. Lately, I just kind of stare at my gear, or my tablet, and... I just don't feel anything pulling me toward it anymore. 

So... yeah. I guess I have.
Did you have a period where you felt extremely happy or on top of the world, which was different from your normal mood?

Um... yeah, I suppose. 

Earlier this month, I felt... I don't know, almost electric, I guess. Really upbeat. But... it wasn't just that. One minute I'd feel like that, and then I'd just... I snapped at a contractor I work with. And my sister. 

It was just over these tiny delays, but... I don't know, it felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting things done. So... yeah, it was different from normal.
Did you feel like you were on top of the world or extremely happy for several days in a row at any point?

Um... yeah, like I just mentioned. It was earlier this month. 

It lasted a few days, I guess. Just... feeling electric and upbeat, and then snapping at my sister or the contractor over those little delays. So... yes. Several days in a row.
Was there a specific period where you felt consistently sad or empty for most of the day?

Um... yeah. 

Lately, it's just... I wake up and there's this heavy, gray feeling in my chest. Even when the apartment is quiet and nothing is wrong, I just... I feel like I could cry over a coffee mug left in the sink. 

So... yeah, most of the day.
Did you feel like your upbeat periods were distinctly different from your normal mood, like a separate episode?
Um... yeah, I guess. It just... it wasn't how I usually am. I don't really know about calling it an episode, but... it was definitely different.
Did these periods of feeling upbeat and periods of feeling sad or empty alternate, or did they happen at separate times?

Um... I don't really know. 

I guess... they just kind of happened when they happened. I wasn't really keeping track of if they were alternating or... whatever. Just... different times, I suppose.
Did you notice if your periods of feeling upbeat and your periods of feeling sad or empty seemed to follow any kind of pattern or cycle?

Um... no. Not really. 

I haven't noticed any kind of pattern. I don't... I don't really chart it out or anything like that. It just... happens when it happens, I guess.
Did your upbeat periods stop abruptly or did they gradually fade away?
Um... I don't really know. I didn't pay that much attention to how they ended. They just... stopped, eventually. I'm not sure if it was sudden or not.
Do you think your periods of feeling upbeat and your periods of feeling sad or empty are related to each other in some way?
I don't really know. I haven't really thought about if they're connected. They just... both happen. I don't really see a link between them.
Did you experience any periods where you felt extremely happy or irritable and had increased energy, and this period lasted for at least several days?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... earlier this month, there was a stretch where I felt almost electric. Just really upbeat. But then... I don't know, it would just switch. I snapped at a contractor, and my sister, just over these tiny delays. It felt like they were personally trying to block me or something. So... yeah, I guess I was irritable, too.
Do you think your periods of feeling upbeat and your periods of feeling sad or empty happen at roughly the same intervals?
I... I haven't really kept track of the timing. I don't know if there's a pattern to when they happen.
Do you think your periods of feeling upbeat and your periods of feeling sad or empty might be part of some kind of larger cycle or pattern in your life?
I'm not sure. I don't really... step back and analyze it like that. Um... I just sort of deal with it when it happens. So, no, I haven't noticed any big pattern.
Have you had more than one period of feeling extremely happy or irritable with increased energy in the past year?
Um... I really don't know. I haven't been counting or anything. So... maybe? I'm just not sure.
Have you had more than one period like the one earlier this month where you felt almost electric and really upbeat in the past year?
I... I really couldn't say. I just... I don't keep track of things like that. It's hard to remember.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient's symptoms of experiencing periods of extreme happiness or irritability with increased energy, as well as periods of feeling sad or empty, suggest a diagnosis of Bipolar I Disorder. The patient's reports of feeling 'electric' and 'upbeat' for several days, followed by irritability and snapping at others, meet the criteria for a manic episode. Additionally, the patient's reports of feeling sad or empty for most of the day, and experiencing a decrease in interest or pleasure in activities, meet the criteria for a depressive episode.
